summary.text: Thad Claggett is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 68 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. A civil engineer and business executive, he chairs the Technology and Innovation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Claggett, listed by Ballotpedia as Thaddeus Claggett, lives in Newark, Ohio, and earned a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering and business administration from Ohio Northern University in 1994.
His career experience includes working as a civil engineer and business executive.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was president of his family’s fourth-generation business and a long-term chairman of the board of several organizations.
Claggett lost the 2020 Republican primary for Ohio House District 71 to incumbent Mark Fraizer.
He won the Ohio House District 68 seat in 2022, defeating Daniel Crawford in the general election, and was re-elected in 2024.
In the 2025–2026 session he chairs the Technology and Innovation Committee and serves on the Commerce and Labor, Government Oversight, and Public Insurance and Pensions committees.
